description: Check marketing or outreach copy (an email, a landing-page draft, a pitch, a social post) for the tells that make it read as AI-generated: cliché vocabulary (delve, unlock, empower, seamlessly integrate, etc.), negative-parallel framing ("not just X, but Y"), hedge words, heavy em-dash use, and diagnosing a problem with no fix in the same breath. No page or markup needed, just the text. Call this before sending copy to a human.
name: check_copy
title: Check copy
